text:
pagerbot: INCIDENT ALERT: Elevated 5xx rate detected for customer Gamma on dedicated cluster gamma-us-west-2. Metric: gateway_5xx_rate > 4% for 5m. Paging on-call: Ben (oncall).

Ben (oncall): ack — jumping in. link: https://monitoring.company/alerts/2199801234 :rotating_light:

Ava SRE: seeing a sharp spike in 5xx + increased p95 latency on gamma's shard. Dashboards show request queue depth climbing and repeated `KV cache eviction` logs.

Ben (oncall): any obvious recent deploys?

DeployBot: new rollout `gamma-optimizer:v2` completed 30m ago to gamma-us-west-2 (canary -> stable) by diego_eng.

Diego (eng-runtime): that rollout touched batching/kv cache heuristics for the runtime. Rolling back can help if it's the cause. Pulling logs now.

Priya (infra): infra metrics show GPU utilization for nodes hosting gamma tenant at ~98% and host-side swap activity. Some nodes have `OOM_kill` events around the start of the spike.

Ava SRE: logs (trimmed):
```
2026-03-15T09:12:01Z runtime[pid=4221]: evicting KV cache for tenant=gamma shard=3 size=1.4G
2026-03-15T09:12:02Z runtime[pid=4221]: failed to alloc cuda memory: out of memory
2026-03-15T09:12:03Z proxy[tenant-gamma]: 502 upstream connection reset
2026-03-15T09:12:05Z runtime[pid=4221]: 5xx: internal server error - allocation failure
```

Diego (eng-runtime): hmm looks like the tenant is trying to use much larger sequence lengths / batch combos than usual. Could be noisy neighbor — either gamma's workload spiked or another tenant on same shard is saturating GPU memory.

Ben (oncall): setting incident priority P1 due to customer impact (Gamma). Sam (CS) can you confirm customer impact?

Sam (CS): customer reports elevated errors in their app, but they're still partially degraded. I'll open a support channel and ping product.

Maria (account): I'm on standby to update the customer if we need to escalate. Wants ETA.

Ava SRE: immediate mitigation options: 1) soft-evict offending pods on shard 3 and force tenant routing to fallback cluster, 2) add per-tenant cgroup GPU memory limit (if available) and throttle, 3) scale up cluster/gang to add capacity, 4) rollback gamma-optimizer rollout. Recommend quick mitigation (1) + (4) in parallel.

Diego (eng-runtime): I'll prepare rollback now. Command: `kubectl -n runtime rollout undo deploy/gamma-runtime --to-revision=23`

Priya (infra): scaling up nodes will take ~8-12 minutes to spin up and attach GPUs; we'll start if needed.

Ben (oncall): Ava, can you soft-evict? Steps we used before: cordon node -> delete runtime pod -> allow scheduler to reassign (but we need to keep gamma balanced).

Ava SRE: doing it for shard 3 now on node gammashard-3b. `kubectl delete pod runtime-gamma-3b-***` -> pod will restart on a different node that has room. Doing one pod at a time.

DeployBot: Rollback `gamma-optimizer:v2` to `v1.9` started by diego_eng.

Diego (eng-runtime): rollback in progress. Watching canary metrics.

Ava SRE: first pod evicted and restarted on node gammashard-3c. Observing reduced memory pressure on that node. Gateway 5xx for that shard dropped from 6.1% -> 3.2% in the next 30s.

Ben (oncall): good. keep doing rolling evictions on the worst-hit nodes, one-at-a-time. Priya, continue to watch infra.

Priya (infra): started provisioning one hot spare GPU node pool (gamma-burst-2) as backup. ETA ~9 minutes.

Sam (CS): notified Gamma support channel: "We're investigating elevated errors, mitigation in progress — rolling restarts and a quick rollback. We'll update in 15m."

Maria (account): customer responded: "Thanks, please keep us posted. Impacting prod requests."

Ava SRE: after 5 evictions across shard-3/4, overall 5xx dropped to 1.1% and latency normalized for most routes. Still intermittent errors on reranking endpoint where KV cache heavy ops live.

Diego (eng-runtime): rollback complete. v1.9 metrics look normal on canary. Pushing to stable now.

DeployBot: Rollout `gamma-optimizer:v1.9` -> stable completed.

Ava SRE: after rollback and evictions, KV eviction logs reduced, no new OOM_kill events. Looks like v2 had an aggressive cache growth bug interacting poorly with tenant-specific seq lengths.

Ben (oncall): status update to incident page. root cause suspected: runtime change (gamma-optimizer:v2) induced aggressive KV cache allocations + noisy tenant request patterns leading to per-node GPU mem exhaustion.

Sam (CS): customer update: "Back to normal for now, occasional 502s but much better. Thanks."

Maria (account): I'll schedule follow-up meeting with Gamma for RCA and SLA credit talk.

Ava SRE: mitigation actions done: rolled back runtime, soft-evicted pods on overloaded nodes, started burst pool (not needed finally), enabled per-tenant throttle temporarily for gamma.

Diego (eng-runtime): next steps on our side: fix cache growth heuristic in v2, add guardrails to prevent >X% per-tenant GPU memory usage, add preflight tests for v2 on high variance seq-length workloads.

Priya (infra): infra follow-ups: add alert for `cuda_memory_pressure > 85%` per-node and an automated eviction play to isolate noisy tenants earlier.

Ben (oncall): tagging incident as mitigated at 2199805020. Keeping thread open for a short postmortem.

Ava SRE: creating postmortem ticket: INC-2199801234. Will add timeline, root cause, and action items.

Diego (eng-runtime): I'll submit a PR with fix + unit/integration test: `runtime#fix/kv-growth-guard`.

Sam (CS): I'll follow up with Gamma and capture any residual errors/edge cases.

Maria (account): please include me in the postmortem and the customer call invite.

Ben (oncall): great handoff. If anyone notices regression, ping this thread or page. Closing status updates in 2h unless new activity. :white_check_mark:
